transcript.text: My dad used to tell me, "Well, if I did
what I was passionate about, I'd be a
bartender at a ski slope." He was like,
"Listen, there's things that you do to
provide for your family, there's things
that you do to provide for yourself,
build a future, have security, and
there's things that you do with your
free time." Now, some people are like,
"Those things can be one of the same."
But, I'll tell you what, the rest of the
world isn't so comfortable that they're
sitting in sunshine and rainbows. But,
here's the crazy part, many of them are
more fulfilled than we are because they
don't see anything wrong with doing the
work. Doing the work is seen as a
dutiful responsibility. It's seen as a
good thing. Guy provides for his family,
nothing wrong with that.
